now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#17
now.text: Mysterio joins the Sinister Six that the Master Planner re-forms at Christmas.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A member of Otto's new Sinister Six.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Mysterio's leader in the Sinister Six.

changes.evidence: Mysterio joins the Master Planner's re-formed Sinister Six at Christmas in #16 'Reinforcement' and is the only member arrested at its end; he does not appear in #17 'Shear Strength' (not in its cast list).

proposed.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#1
proposed.text: Toomes storms into Oscorp and berates Otto, his old colleague, for the theft of his Tech Flight design. As he is thrown out, he tells Otto he no longer blames him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An old colleague who blames, then forgives, Otto.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The old colleague who brought Toomes's work to Oscorp.

changes.evidence: The scene the current stage 0 opens with (Toomes blames Otto at Oscorp, then says he no longer blames him) happens in #1 'Survival of the Fittest', not #11. Stage 0 text should then keep only the #11 part, e.g. 'In prison, the Vulture joins Otto's plan to break out and form the Sinister Six, and becomes his right hand.'

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#11
now.text: When Toomes storms into Oscorp, he first blames Otto for stealing his work, then forgives him. Later the Vulture joins Otto's Sinister Six and becomes his right hand.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Otto's right hand in the Sinister Six.

proposed.text: In prison, the Vulture joins Otto's plan to break out and form the Sinister Six, and becomes his right hand.

changes.evidence: Goes with the added #1 stage: in #11 'Group Therapy' Otto, from Ryker's, has Toomes gather the other villains and they break out as the Sinister Six; the Oscorp confrontation is #1.

now.title: Spider-Man (1994)#62
now.text: On the Beyonder's world, Doctor Doom takes over Doctor Octopus's realm.

changes.evidence: In #62 'The Gauntlet of the Red Skull' Doom is only mentioned (Ock's realm was taken by Doom); Doom is on screen with Ock in #63 'Doom', which shows he dethroned Doctor Octopus and later banishes the villains back to Earth.

proposed.title: Spider-Man (1994)#57
proposed.text: The Chameleon betrays the Kingpin and the Insidious Six, stealing the last keys so Kragov can free the Red Skull, who then traps the Six.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: One of Doctor Octopus's Six, who betrays the team.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Leads the Six the Chameleon betrays.

changes.evidence: In #57 'The Six Fight Again' the Chameleon leaves the Insidious Six: he snatches the last keys, betrays Kingpin and helps Kragov release the Red Skull, who traps Kingpin's Six and Spider-Man's side.
In #28 'Doctor Strange' Wong only fights Mordo's followers; Strange and Spider-Man are the ones who face Dormammu. Wong and Dormammu never deal with each other, and 'The demon Wong fights' is untrue.

proposed.title: Spider-Man (1994)#1
proposed.text: The Lizard attacks Eddie, who then overhears that Curt Connors is the Lizard and tries to expose him, but Connors, human again, answers his door.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The scientist Eddie tries to expose as the Lizard.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A reporter who tries to expose him as the Lizard.

changes.evidence: In #1 'Night of the Lizard' the Lizard attacks Eddie, Eddie eavesdrops on Margaret Connors and runs to publish; next morning he tells Jameson the Lizard is Curt Connors, but Connors answers the door in human form.

now.title: Spider-Man (1994)#38
now.text: Back as Venom, Eddie attacks Jameson and overpowers Spider-Man, then leaves with Dr. Kafka.

proposed.text: Back as Venom, Eddie storms the Daily Bugle and attacks Jameson, the boss who fired him.

changes.evidence: In #38 'Carnage' Venom attacks Jameson at the Bugle, then turns on Spider-Man until Iron Man arrives and stops him, and he flees; he does not overpower Spider-Man and leave with Kafka (she finds him later).

proposed.title: Spider-Man (1994)#32
proposed.text: Felicia turns Peter down, then happily accepts when Jason asks her to dinner, and the two begin dating.

changes.evidence: In #32 'Rocket Racer' Jason (Phillips) Macendale asks Felicia out, she agrees, and they begin dating; #40 is their engagement and his unmasking.

owner_calls.question: The only stage is on #11, but its first half (Otto runs the experiment that turns Marko into the Sandman) happens on screen in #5 'Competition'. Add an earlier #5 stage, and with which kind?
options: Add a #5 stage (kind enemy) for the experiment and keep #11 for the Sinister Six
Add a #5 stage with another kind
owner_calls.evidence: #5: Osborn makes a reluctant Octavius run the silicon experiment on Marko, who turns to sand and rages to be let out. #11: Sandman joins Otto's Sinister Six.

owner_calls.question: The only stage is on #11, but its first half (Otto bonds O'Hirn to the rhino armor) happens on screen in #6 'The Invisible Hand'. Add an earlier #6 stage, and with which kind?
options: Add a #6 stage (kind enemy) for the armor and keep #11 for the Sinister Six
Add a #6 stage with another kind
owner_calls.evidence: #6: a wary Octavius, pushed by Hammerhead, attaches the rhino exoskeleton to O'Hirn. #11: Rhino breaks Otto out and joins the Sinister Six.
